propositions: Three near-identical walkers for discovering replacement links should be consolidated into one shared core function with liveness mode and reduce-failure posture as parameters.
The three walkers differ in class guards and ticket-type filtering which must remain at wrapper level to preserve existing behavior and exemptions.
The walk conjunction of find_inbound_relationships and supersedes must appear uniquely in close_disposition.py with a construct-uniqueness guard test scanning src/rebar excluding the owner module.
One-line wrapper seams _has_live_replacement_link and _recorded_replacement_target must retain exact names and signatures to preserve monkeypatch compatibility with 738a pinning tests.
_NON_COMPLETION_BUG_CLASSES must become an alias to DISPOSITION_CLASSES (same object) so the two cannot drift as they did in bug frolicky-dependable-peccary.
The reduce-failure divergence must be preserved explicitly via on_subject_unreadable parameter: stop for live-mode callers, continue for _recorded_replacement_target.
